verdict.rationale: Cline shows diffs for every edit with review/modify/revert and checkpoints/undo (cline-gh-1, cline-docs-30), and Plan mode lets you strategize before executing changes (cline-docs-11). However, there's no evidence of integrated automated 'checks' (test runners, linters as a gating step, CI status surfacing) beyond a passing mention of 'linter-aware fixes' — no dedicated test/CI review workflow, no PR-level diff review tooling, and no independent hands-on account of using diffs+checks to catch bugs before merge. missing for 10: dedicated automated test/check execution tied to diff review, PR-based review workflow, independent verification that this catches real bugs pre-merge.
